# Unicode character data

UnicodeData.txt and NameAliases.txt are unmodified Unicode Character Database
17.0.0 inputs downloaded from https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/.
LICENSE.txt is the accompanying Unicode License V3, retrieved from
https://www.unicode.org/license.txt. The generated src/unicode_data.inc includes
character ranges/categories/names and control-name aliases. It is regenerated
offline using tools/Generate-Unicode.py, which checks the pinned SHA-256 hashes.
